_comment: Curation of which publications belong on the LAB site.
Policy: the lab page lists only research led by AI-EDA Lab (NYCU era, 2020+).
Papers co-advised with other groups, and Prof. Lin's pre-NYCU work, live on his
personal page / DBLP instead, so the lab never claims another group's output.
First pass drafted 2026-09-02 by heuristic (2020+, no other faculty co-author).
PENDING PROF. LIN'S CONFIRMATION - edit the include list freely; titles must
include: Netlistify: Transforming Circuit Schematics into Netlists with Deep Learning

Late Breaking Results: PVT-Sensitive Delay Fitting for High-Performance Computing
Automatic Analog Schematic Diagram Generation based on Building Block Classification and Reinforcement Learning
A Novel Technology Mapper for Complex Universal Gates

_excluded_nycu_era: FOR PROF. LIN'S REVIEW - the 11 papers from 2020 onward that were NOT included, and why.
To move one onto the lab page, cut its exact title into the include list above and rerun the injection.

2023 IEEE TCAD | On Reducing LDE Variations in Modern Analog Placement | co-authored with Prof. Hung-Ming Chen
2023 IEEE TCAD | Pole-Aware Analog Layout Synthesis Considering Monotonic Current Flows and Wire Crossings | co-authored with Prof. Hung-Ming Chen
2023 SMACD | Layout Synthesis of Analog Primitive Cells with Variational Autoencoder | co-authored with Profs. Chien-Nan Jimmy Liu and Hung-Ming Chen
2022 ASP-DAC | Common-Centroid Layout for Active and Passive Devices: A Review and the Road Ahead | Univ. of Minnesota-led survey (Profs. Harjani, Sapatnekar)
2022 SMACD | On Optimizing Capacitor Array Design for Advanced Node SAR ADC | multi-PI project (Profs. Jou, Liu, Chen)
2020 DAC LBR | Late Breaking Results: Pole-aware Analog Placement Considering Monotonic Current Flow and Crossing-Wire Minimization | co-authored with Prof. Hung-Ming Chen
2020 ICCAD | Achieving Analog Layout Integrity through Learning and Migration (invited talk) | joint invited talk with Profs. Liu and Chen
2020 ICCAD | Overview of 2020 CAD Contest at ICCAD | contest-organizer overview, not lab research
Also excluded: all 45 papers before 2020 (pre-NYCU: CCU and SpringSoft era) - they live on Prof. Lin's page and DBLP.

Borderline INCLUDES worth double-checking: 'A Novel Technology Mapper for Complex Universal Gates' (ASP-DAC 2021) and the Corner-Stitching TCAD 2020 paper - both may date to the CCU era despite the publication year.
